description: Change the consent banner. Only the fields you pass are changed.

consent_mode_type.description: advanced (default): Google tags send cookieless pings before consent. basic: the loader holds Google tags back until the visitor consents.

google_consent_mode_enabled.description: Send Google Consent Mode v2 signals (all plans)

show_reject_button.description: Show Reject all on the first layer (keep true in the EU)

tracker_blocking.description: on: known trackers (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Hotjar, ...) wait for consent. monitor: only list them in the browser console. off: leave them alone.

name: update_widget_config
